# Awarse Labs

> Local-first AI agents for FinOps and QA automation built on FastMCP.

## Core Products & Capabilities
- **awarse-mcp**: Self-healing browser automation server integrating Playwright with LLM-assisted locator repair.
- **FastMCP Architecture**: Ephemeral, local-first execution eliminating SaaS overhead.
- **Flaky Test Remediation**: Automated detection and healing of broken UI selectors in test pipelines.

## Links & Repositories
- Official Repository: https://github.com/awarselabs/awarse-mcp
- Glama Registry: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/awarselabs/awarse-mcp
- Documentation: https://awarselabs.com/docs
